failure_patterns.pattern: cache_update_scope_misuse: Agents repeated cached searches, processed unchanged domains, or skipped filtering a cached result when the user added criteria.

rejected_edits.content: Treat a new detail as actionable only if it requests a supported operation or maps to a supported parameter for the affected domain. A detail with no supported field for that domain (for example, passenger count when the flight tools have no passenger-count parameter) does not justify retrieving, saving, or repeating completed results; use a no-op if nothing else changed.
rejected_edits.target: A no-op response is appropriate only when the latest turn adds no actionable request and compatible cached results already cover all active requests.

rejected_edits.content: - Call `search_nearest` only when the user explicitly requests proximity between domains; mentioning a hotel and attractions or restaurants for the same trip or city does not by itself imply proximity. For an active explicit proximity request, if the user adds filterable criteria for either domain, retrieve and filter that domain's compatible cached results first, then pass the updated results to `search_nearest` so the nearest results satisfy the new criteria. For proximity to a specifically named place or entity, ensure one input is a compatible result that actually covers that named anchor; a broader result from the same domain is not a substitute. If no compatible cached result covers it, search for the anchor using its exact entity text. `search_nearest` requires exactly two populated domain-result inputs: obtain both relevant result objects and never pass `None` for either one. Set `groupBy` to the domain the user wants prioritized.
rejected_edits.target: - Call `search_nearest` only when the user explicitly requests proximity between domains; mentioning a hotel and attractions or restaurants for the same trip or city does not by itself imply proximity. For explicit proximity requests, use the relevant hotel and attraction or restaurant results with `search_nearest`. Set `groupBy` to the domain the user wants prioritized.

rejected_edits.content: - For restaurant searches, map stated dietary restrictions or needs to the corresponding supported accommodation field set to `True` (for example, dairy-free to `has_dairy_allergy_options=True` and gluten-free to `has_gluten_free_options=True`). For a nightshade allergy, use `has_tomato_allergy_options=True` as the closest available supported filter, not an unrelated allergy option; treat it as a proxy, not confirmation that every nightshade ingredient is accommodated. Retain any active cuisine and other restaurant criteria.
